status: Exploratory development protocol written before this experiment's results; no final service or policy winner is selected.
question: Can a transparent hold-versus-restore lookahead save transfers without the large drawdown deterioration seen in growth-only execution? Compare two declared rules on frozen strict172 products; do not introduce an unelicited risk-aversion coefficient.

data.guard: Use safeinvest.data.load_paths with allow_final=False. Only complete development paths1--120 are parsed. Hashing the original combined data file is provenance, not permission to parse final returns.
data.history: Development data and earlier final results have already been used. These are reused-development, whole-path internal comparisons, not a new blind holdout.

frozen_inputs.freeze_rule: Resolve and record these exact SHA256 hashes before any new replay; verify both before and after. Reuse their effective assignments, local172/global232 mapping, products, all six contexts, original H/L, cost and folds. No menu, gamma, assignment, trigger or forecast selection is fitted from the new outcomes.

reference_forecast.law: At decision year t, use each training scenario's joint asset-return/inflation suffix t..H as one equally weighted forecast continuation. All dates refer to the original fresh client horizon and original calendar columns1..H. Preserve each suffix's chronological order and joint asset/inflation dependence.
reference_forecast.sample: Full context uses120 training paths; each outer context uses exactly its96 training paths, excluding all24 test paths. No realized current test return or future test return is supplied to a decision. Forecast identities remain fixed from inception.
reference_forecast.interpretation: This is a finite unconditional reference fan of continuations from the observed account state. It ignores predictive information in the client's observed market history. Recombining the fan at later years need not be the conditional law of a single dynamically consistent scenario model.
reference_forecast.no_guarantee: Exact averaging over the fan has no Monte Carlo sampling noise, but it does have estimation and specification error. Do not invoke Bellman optimality, rollout improvement or a calibrated full-horizon risk certificate for the actual repeatedly replanned policy. Independent paths do not imply annual IID; annual IID is not assumed here.

state_and_accounting.state: Actual nominal holdings, CPI, real wealth, real historical peak, running MDD, absorbing everbreached flag, original H/L, elapsed time and frozen version. Each client H begins afresh at pre-fee100/all bills/CPI1/peak100/MDD0.
state_and_accounting.fees: Exact self-financing actual transferred amount counted once before the year's return, including initial allocation. No fixed cost, terminal liquidation fee, tax or refund. Hold makes no discretionary transfer; balances still grow with each asset return.
state_and_accounting.event: Only initial and annual-endpoint net real wealth observations; strict running MDD minus original individual L greater than1e-12. No fee-instant or intrayear observation is inserted.
state_and_accounting.pending: After the actual policy's first crossing, hold actual asset quantities through original H. This is the same explicit no-human-response-through-H proxy, not an estimate of adviser behavior. No reset, target update, re-entry or adviser return.
state_and_accounting.onboarding_review: Existing effective Review remains null financial outcomes for every policy. All original client/path rows remain in the denominator.

lookahead.initial_allocation: Mandatory common initial allocation in all three policies, preserving the frozen product's inception convention. Subsequent decisions are evaluated only at their actual beginning-of-year state.
lookahead.baseline_B: After the compared current action, restore the frozen target at each later decision until that simulated continuation's own first annual-endpoint breach; then hold through original H. The continuation uses its own real peak, running MDD and absorbing breach, including history before the current decision.
lookahead.quantities: For each action a, average log(R_H/R_current) over the common training fan to obtain Qg(a), and count final everbreached flags to obtain Qbad_count(a). Use total log units; annualized values, when reported, divide by original H, never remaining h. Every current and future baseline fee is included once.
lookahead.growth_only_rule: Before an actual breach and after inception, restore iff Qg(restore)-Qg(hold)>1e-12. Otherwise hold. The numerical tie guard is in total-log units and is not a material economic benefit threshold.
lookahead.pareto_hold_rule: Before an actual breach and after inception, hold iff Qg(hold)>=Qg(restore)-1e-12 AND Qbad_count(hold)<=Qbad_count(restore). Otherwise restore. The risk comparison uses exact integer counts on the same equally weighted fan; no new probability margin, risk price, L change or response-delay parameter is introduced.
lookahead.reference_policy: Annual restore until own first crossing, then pending hold. First reproduce its paired annual counterpart against the frozen strict172 annual metrics, and independently check the pending reference.
lookahead.meaning: Pareto-hold is a study of when holding is model-predicted not to sacrifice either growth or risk relative to restoring and then following B. A restoration can still sacrifice estimated growth when holding increases estimated breach risk. This is a baseline-relative risk restriction, not a full proof of Q2's final benefit gate or q<=alpha.

evaluation.contexts: One full-development120 context and five frozen96-train/24-test outer contexts. Full is descriptive resubstitution. Pool only the one OOF observation per scenario/client/policy; rules differ by fold and their training sets overlap.
evaluation.primary_outputs: Per original client/path/policy: assigned/null status, H/L/target/indices, actual wealth and action traces, total fees and moved amounts, trade fraction, annualized log growth, CAGR, full-H MDD, everbreach and first crossing. Summary median/P10 CAGR, median/P90/CVaR90 MDD, excess, coverage and paired differences. No performance imputation for Review.
evaluation.gate_diagnostics: For each post-inception automatic pre-breach decision save Qg_hold/restore, Qbad counts, training fan denominator, chosen action, predicted net growth advantage, risk change and reason. Separate mandatory inception and already-pending hold. Reconcile realized trades/fees with the decision record and separately count restoration decisions with a predicted growth sacrifice.
evaluation.risk: Changing actions before first breach changes the whole policy; its breach counts need not equal annual/pending. Re-evaluate all paths. Neither static risk screens, static CP bounds, nested gamma choices nor post-breach coupling certify these policies.
evaluation.no_selection: Report both declared candidates regardless of results; do not choose a final winner, change product targets, search an eta grid or tune a threshold using OOF outcomes. Any new method or choice requires a separate protocol and explicit reused-data status.
evaluation.forecast_influence_diagnostic: At each recorded pre-breach post-inception gate, delete each one training forecast path from the SAME current-state fan, recompute the two-action mean log score and integer risk-count comparison, and count recommendations that change. This is only local fan influence with the actual state and all products/folds fixed; not a full-policy leave-one-out refit, confidence interval or reason to tune the gate. For N=1 leave this diagnostic null.

acceptance: Source/input snapshots match at start/end; only guarded1--120 return arrays are loaded.
Frozen strict172 local/global mapping, effective assignments, target weights and full/outer train/test identities match.
Exact original annual replay matches all saved assigned path metrics; pending baseline matches the independently audited financial-trigger rule.

On tiny declared synthetic fans, both action Q values match independent path enumeration and b remains absorbing. Test H1, fees, inflation, pending continuation, history peaks and original-H growth units.
No current evaluation-year or future evaluation return is passed into a decision; a changed future actual path leaves the earlier action unchanged with the same state and training fan.
Replay every actual fee/wealth/state/action transition; audit a declared deterministic subset of Q values using independent bisection and scalar fan simulation.
Each original client has120 full and120 pooled OOF rows per policy including null Review; no duplicated or missing scenario, and no zero-filled Review outcomes.
Describe forecast mismatch, reused development, model-relative gates and the remaining Q2/risk/liquidity limitations without extrapolating a safety guarantee.

theoretical_reference.title: Dimitri Bertsekas, Rollout, Policy Iteration, and Distributed Reinforcement Learning
theoretical_reference.support_scope: General one-step rollout evaluates current actions followed by a base policy. Exact model-consistent improvement results do not apply automatically to this recombined empirical fan heuristic. The specialized accounting, two declared gates and limitations here are our own design.

independent_market_Q_audit_subset.scenario: Smallest evaluation scenario ID in each of the six contexts, for each served client and each of the two candidate policies.
independent_market_Q_audit_subset.eligibility: Audit only selected decisions with an actual pre-breach Q value. If initial/pending or otherwise absent, record a skip; do not replace it with a favorable or more interesting case.
independent_market_Q_audit_subset.calculation: Independent scalar path simulation and bisection fees for both current actions followed by B, using all frozen training suffixes; compare Qg, integer Qbad and delete-one action influence.
